fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of DLLs that are known to be abused from suspicious locations
fields.name: Abusable DLL Potential Sideloading From Suspicious Location
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((module.path contains "\\coreclr.dll" or module.path contains "\\facesdk.dll" or module.path contains "\\HPCustPartUI.dll" or module.path contains "\\libcef.dll" or module.path contains "\\ZIPDLL.dll") and ((module.path contains ":\\Perflogs\\" or module.path contains ":\\Users\\Public\\" or module.path contains "\\Temporary Internet" or module.path contains "\\Windows\\Temp\\") or ((module.path contains ":\\Users\\" and module.path contains "\\Favorites\\") or (module.path contains ":\\Users\\" and module.path contains "\\Favourites\\") or (module.path contains ":\\Users\\" and module.path contains "\\Contacts\\") or (module.path contains ":\\Users\\" and module.path contains "\\Pictures\\")))))
